subject: Onboarding hold: request for sandbox top-up & short extension while connector is reworked
messages:
From: Claire Ho <claire@skyward.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luis Moreno <luis@skyward.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — build blocked by connector rework

Hi Olga,

Quick update from our side — engineering dug into the connector failure this morning and found the issue is deeper than we first thought: the third-party data mapping library we relied on needs a small rewrite to match our schema changes. Our SREs say it will be ~10 business days to finish and validate.

We are blocked on end-to-end tests and cannot complete the sandbox-driven acceptance criteria. That means our pilot launch window slides by about two weeks.

Two asks:
- Could Redwood provide a short trial extension (2 weeks) so we can complete validation without losing momentum?
- Can you top up our sandbox tokens/credits while we rework the connector — we’re close to exhausting the allocated credits for integration tests.

I attached the minimal error logs we captured and the updated onboarding checklist. Appreciate any flexibility here — this pilot is strategic for Skyward and we want to keep the timeline once engineering clears it.

Thanks,
Claire
Onboarding Lead
Skyward AI

Attachment: connector-stacktrace-20270720.txt (text)
Attachment: onboarding-plan-v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Ho <claire@skyward.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — build blocked by connector rework

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear note and the logs. I’m sorry you hit the rework mid-onboarding; we’ve seen this pattern with schema drift before.

Quick internal plan:
- I’ve looped in Dev (engineering) to confirm the impact and recommend a mitigation timeline.
- I’ll prepare a formal request for a 2-week trial extension + sandbox top-up while you finish the connector rewrite and validation.

Can you confirm how many additional tokens you estimate will cover your end-to-end test matrix? A ballpark number is fine (e.g., 50k / 100k tokens). That will help me make the promo approval request.

I’ll follow up once Dev confirms the ETA. We want to avoid the pilot collapsing for scheduling reasons.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — build blocked by connector rework

Thanks for the ping, Olga. Saw Claire’s logs. Quick technical read:
- The stacktrace indicates the mapping layer throws on unexpected nested arrays during schema parse.
- Fix is straightforward but requires a small refactor and CI validation against their sample payloads.
- I estimate 8–12 business days for a small team (including test coverage and partner verification).

Regarding tokens: for full E2E validation across noisy sampling (we run multiple seeds and stress runs) I recommend a 100,000 token top-up. If leadership prefers we can do a smaller interim top-up (50k) with the option to extend once tests pass.

If useful I can prepare a short engineering note for Marissa/finance explaining the timeline and why the safety net is necessary; might help speed approval.

— Dev
Principal Engineer, Integrations
Redwood Inference

Marissa — following the engineering assessment, Skyward will need ~10 business days to complete a connector rewrite. They are a high-fit pilot and the commercial cadence depends on keeping the pilot on track after validation.

Request details:
- Trial extension: +14 days to current sandbox end date (requested by customer).
- Sandbox credit: 100,000 tokens top-up (one-time).
- Reason: engineering rework of connector due to schema drift; need to run full E2E stress and validation.
- Attachments: connector logs + onboarding plan (attached to the thread).
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/rdw-2027-8791

Dev has prepared a brief note outlining the technical justification (included above). If you approve I’ll issue the credits and update the HubSpot deal notes + trial dates. If partial approval is preferred, 50k tokens + 10-day extension would be our fallback.

Thanks — can you confirm by EOD so we can keep Skyward’s engineering sprint schedule intact?

Olga
Enterprise Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
